method: Fine D2Q9 through 32768. Cubic smoothstep blends independently evolving fine and corrected coarse fields through 65536. Then only the frozen coarse-grid Hankel correction is used.
primary: All 315 positive fields satisfy relative interior velocity L2 <=0.01 and maximum local vector difference <=0.01 U; initial rest separately.
secondary: Test 64 common four-tick intervals at each end of the overlap. Record field and increment error. No derivative acceptance threshold was set.
design: One fixed overlap as long as the initial fine-only interval; no fit, change to the frozen weights, or target-specific tuning. Compare against the hard rule.
